sourcesRead.read_scope: January 22 heading for Moore message; preceding January 28 Grivot order and February 19 Smith letter kept separate.
Moore message, January 22: slaveholding-State interests, immediate resistance and sovereignty. Full page text read; image inspected.
Moore message, January 22: military seizures, responsibility to legislature and arms sent to Mississippi. Full page text read; image inspected.
End and signature of Moore message; following January 12 fort-seizure report read separately. No third-party candour judgment inferred.
Andrew B. Moore to Alabama convention January 8 reports Perry ordered occupation and sought aid. Perry January 10 cover and senators enclosure distinguished. Image inspected.
Perry message heading February 2 and opening sovereignty/public-duty paragraphs. Image inspected. Earlier Georgia declaration on same page explicitly excluded.
Perry message continuation: sovereignty and resistance to Federal force. Political claims are his, not adopted as fact.
Perry message continuation: deprecates war, arms for deterrence, preparation and joint defence; bounded conduct, not unconditional aggression.
Perry message conclusion: prepare quota, appropriate money, no estimate available; signature. Image inspected. Following Alabama correspondence excluded.
